themes.title: Bitcoin holds below $70,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin stayed under $70,000 through Friday after breaking below it Thursday night; Fortune put it at $69,135 at 8:30 AM ET, down about 5.6% from the previous morning and about 15% over the past month (Fortune; KuCoin News).

themes.title: Rate-hike bets and higher yields
themes.summary: Hotter U.S. inflation data lifted expectations of a December Fed rate hike, pushing the dollar and Treasury yields higher and weighing on risk assets, along with the selloff in AI-linked stocks after Nvidia's CEO resigned (crypto.news; Kiplinger).

themes.title: Heavy liquidations
themes.summary: CoinGlass data showed about $1.23 billion of leveraged positions liquidated over 24 hours early Friday, including about $677.5 million in bitcoin and $249.8 million in ether, mostly bets on rising prices (crypto.news).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs had $47.7 million of net outflows on Nov. 12, a sixth straight day; Glassnode counted about $1.6 billion of outflows over 20 trading sessions (KuCoin News; crypto.news).

themes.title: Shrinking stablecoin supply
themes.summary: Glassnode reported stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion over the 30 days through Nov. 9, the largest contraction since June 2022 (crypto.news).
